[[Brrne's Recurve Bow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Famished Ancient Brrne]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Raisu Palace]] or [[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] -10 (while [[attacking]])
:Lengthens [[Crippled]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as the [[Naga Longbow]], [[dye]]d red.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance and [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a replica for this item with the same stats. Inscriptions on replicas affect core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
*One of the following [[recurve bow]]s:
**[[Sturdy Recurve Bow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Recurve Bow]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Recurve Bow]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Recurve Bow of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Recurve Bow]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Crippling]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|To the Pain]]" inscription

==Unique counterpart==
[[Nandet's Recurve Bow]] has identical stats of this item.
